name: Chef’s Crew
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level adept 1, bard 1, cleric 1, medium 1, mesmerist 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, summoner 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect up to 2 + 1/level invisible, mindless, shapeless servants
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You summon invisible, mindless, shapeless forces to assist in running a kitchen. Each unseen chef can perform a simple, repetitive task for cooking as directed, such as turning a spit, cutting vegetables, stirring soup, or kneading bread. They cannot change to a different task until directed by you as a free action. The unseen chefs use your Profession (brewer, butcher, or cook) check when performing the relevant tasks.

Unseen chefs act in all other ways like unseen servants. They cannot fly, climb, or swim, cannot attack, dissipate if they take more than 6 points of damage, and cease to exist if they are sent out of the spell’s range.
